item.title: AP Computer Science A & Principles Tutoring
item.description:
One-on-one online AP CS support

AP Computer Science tutoring

I tutor both AP Computer Science A and AP Computer Science Principles. Lessons focus on the concepts a student is missing, a reliable way to reason through problems, and the confidence to write, read, test, and explain their own work.

Ask about AP CS tutoring See all tutoring subjects →

AP Computer Science A

AP Computer Science A centers on programming and problem-solving in Java. I can help students strengthen the foundations behind their classwork: tracing code, variables and expressions, conditionals, loops, methods, classes and objects, arrays and collections, algorithms, testing, and debugging.

item.title: Online Coding and Math Tutoring for Kids and Teens
item.description:
Private lessons over Zoom

Online coding and math tutoring

Personalized lessons for kids, teens, and college students—from first projects in Scratch and Python to math support, AP Computer Science, college coursework, and more advanced programming.

Ask about lessons Read common questions ↓

Who lessons are for

  • A beginner who is curious about programming but does not know where to start
  • A Scratch creator ready to understand more advanced concepts or try Python
  • A high school or college student who wants patient help with a computer science course
  • An AP Computer Science A or AP Computer Science Principles student who wants clearer explanations and deliberate practice
  • A student who wants to understand difficult math concepts and develop stronger problem-solving habits
  • A young programmer with a game, website, app, or other project idea
  • A learner who knows some syntax but wants to become better at solving problems independently

No prior coding experience is required. Family members do not need to know programming either.
